description: Legacy alias of recent_skwirl; prefer recent_skwirl. List the connected user's newest Skwirl saves, newest creation date first. Recent means the latest limit notes across all time, with no time window: limit is 1–20, default 5. Returns title, summary (up to 140 characters), note ID and saved date, or 'No matching saves.' Use for browsing recent additions; use search_stash for relevance, list_stash_mentions for named entities, and get_stash_note for a full note. Usage examples: recent_stash({"limit":5}); recent_stash({}). Returns text.

limit.description: Integer result count from 1 to 20; defaults to 5. Example: 5.

name: recent_stash
title: Browse recent saves (legacy alias)
